answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization models aim to extract essential information from long documents and to generate short, concise and readable text.
datasets: AdaptSum (dialog, email, movie review, debate, social media, science)

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics We use ROUGE to measure the quality of the summary produced in our experiments. Following the previous work, we report ROUGE F1 (ROUGE-1) on the AdaptSum dataset.
